crossRefs.note: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things.…

translations.web: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
translations.bsb: Will he beg you for mercy or speak to you softly?
translations.kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft
translations.asv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Or will he speak soft words unto thee?
